title: Unverified Positive Isolation on Hydrocarbon Transfer Line
narrative_text: During scheduled maintenance on a hydrocarbon transfer line, work began after the upstream valve was closed. Positive isolation was not verified with a pressure test before flange breaking commenced. Residual pressure was present in the line. The worker positioned near the flange noticed a slight release and immediately stepped back. Work was stopped and the line was re-isolated and verified before continuing. No injury occurred.
exposure_description: Worker positioned near the flange at the moment of release
potential_consequence: Uncontrolled release leading to chemical exposure, flash fire, or projectile line-of-fire injury, up to fatal
evidence_sentence: Positive isolation was not verified with a pressure test before flange breaking commenced.

title: Worker Standing Beneath Suspended Derrick Rigging Load
narrative_text: Worker briefly stood beneath a suspended 2.5-ton manifold spool while repositioning rigging slings during a crane lift on the drilling pad. Rigging supervisor sounded the air horn and halted the lift immediately. Exclusion zone was not demarcated with physical barrier tape.
exposure_description: Worker directly beneath suspended 2.5-ton manifold spool
potential_consequence: Crush / blunt force trauma fatality from suspended load drop
evidence_sentence: Worker briefly stood beneath a suspended 2.5-ton manifold spool while repositioning rigging slings during a crane lift.

title: Vessel Entry Without Multi-Gas Atmospheric Clearance
narrative_text: Entry made into crude separator vessel before atmospheric gas testing was completed; crew was behind schedule on vessel desanding turnaround. Standby observer arrived 15 minutes after technician had already entered the vessel interior.
exposure_description: Technician inside unventilated separator vessel interior
potential_consequence: Asphyxiation or fatal H2S poisoning in confined vessel space
evidence_sentence: Entry made into crude separator vessel before atmospheric gas testing was completed; crew was behind schedule.

title: Hot Grinding Performed Near Flammable Vent Header
narrative_text: Angle grinding performed on structural steel beam located 3.5 meters from an open process vent stack without first confirming the area was free of flammable vapor. Continuous LEL detector was not deployed at spark path.
exposure_description: Grinding spark shower directly directed toward vent header
potential_consequence: Hydrocarbon vapor cloud explosion and catastrophic unit fire
evidence_sentence: Grinding performed near an open vent stack without first confirming the area was free of flammable vapor.

title: Elevated Derrick Access via Uncertified Makeshift Planking
narrative_text: Access to an elevated platform at 6.2 meters made via a make-shift scaffold plank instead of approved access equipment; no fall-arrest harness observed on rig hand. Work stopped by safety officer.
exposure_description: Rig hand traversing unsecured plank at 6.2m elevation
potential_consequence: Fatal fall from height onto steel wellhead manifold
evidence_sentence: Access to an elevated platform made via a make-shift platform instead of approved access equipment; no fall-arrest harness observed.

title: Permit-to-Work Isolation Points Discrepancy in Field
narrative_text: Permit-to-work was signed for compressor valve maintenance, but the isolation points listed on the PTW certificate did not match what was physically locked in the field. Tagged valve was bypass line BV-104 instead of main suction valve SV-104.
exposure_description: Maintenance technician preparing to disassemble un-isolated suction bonnet
potential_consequence: High-pressure gas blowout (65 bar) causing fatal blast trauma and fire
evidence_sentence: Permit-to-work was signed, but the isolation points listed did not match what was physically isolated in the field.

title: Mobile Phone Distraction While Driving Crew Bus on Lease Road
narrative_text: Driver observed using a handheld mobile phone briefly while transporting 8 operations personnel between pump stations on single-lane unpaved lease road at 45 km/h during heavy rain.
exposure_description: 8 passengers in moving crew bus in wet road conditions
potential_consequence: Vehicle rollover or head-on collision causing serious injury
evidence_sentence: Driver observed using a mobile phone briefly while transporting personnel between sites.

title: High-Pressure Vessel Interlock Silenced Without Management of Change
narrative_text: High-pressure alarm (PSH-401) on 2nd-stage condensate separator vessel was silenced and jumpered in the control DCS pending a spare transmitter, without a documented Management of Change risk assessment or mitigating field operator surveillance.
exposure_description: Plant operators in separator area without automatic overpressure warning
potential_consequence: Vessel overpressurization, catastrophic shell rupture, and massive vapor cloud fire
evidence_sentence: Pressure alarm on a vessel was silenced pending a spare part, without a documented risk assessment for the interim period.

title: Uncoordinated Crane Lift Above Live Hot Work Grinding Crew
narrative_text: During a turnaround shutdown, a 40-ton mobile crane swung a heavy drill collar package directly over a structural grinding crew in the adjacent bay without a joint SIMOPS review, barricades, or pre-lift coordination horn.
exposure_description: Welder and assistant directly underneath swinging crane radius
potential_consequence: Catastrophic crush fatality and structural strike initiating igniteable fire
evidence_sentence: During a shutdown, a crane lift and hot-work grinding proceeded in adjoining areas without a documented SIMOPS review.

title: Emergency Blowdown Valve Handwheel Loose and Slipping
narrative_text: Emergency blowdown valve BDV-09 handwheel felt loose and slipping on stem spline during weekly operator walk-around; reported after use rather than prior to startup.
potential_consequence: Delayed emergency depressurization during loss of containment
evidence_sentence: A valve wheel felt loose and was reported after use, rather than before — a possible early sign of degradation.

title: Lumbar Muscle Strain While Moving Submersible Pump Casing
narrative_text: Mechanic experienced acute lower-back lumbar strain while manually lifting a 28 kg steel pump component from workbench to pallet; employee sent to company hospital for physiotherapy. First-aid and painkiller medication administered.
potential_consequence: Musculoskeletal strain / lost time injury (no fatal escalation mechanism)
evidence_sentence: Worker experienced lower-back strain while manually lifting a component; first-aid treatment given.

title: Contradictory Isolation Claim on Crude Distillation Manifold
narrative_text: Primary log stated isolation completed by day shift. Later during line flange cracking at 19:30, isolation could not be confirmed by the second incoming night technician before bolts were loosened. Flange vented trace volatile condensate onto drip tray.
exposure_description: Night technician directly loosening bolts at flange
potential_consequence: Hot condensate spray / vapor cloud flash fire injuring technician
evidence_sentence: Isolation could not be confirmed by the second technician before work proceeded.

title: Heavy Crane Lift with Fully Demarcated & Clear Exclusion Zone
narrative_text: During heavy 60-ton mast hoist, no personnel were inside the exclusion zone at any point during the lift. Barricades, marshals, and horn signals were maintained intact.
exposure_description: No personnel exposed; exclusion zone strictly maintained
potential_consequence: None — barrier verified intact and exposure zero
evidence_sentence: No personnel were inside the exclusion zone at any point during the lift.

title: Vague Safety Concern Near Process Facility
narrative_text: Safety issue observed near the process area. Reported for awareness and general plant review.
evidence_sentence: Safety issue observed near the process area. Reported for awareness.

title: Routine Mainline Pressure Log Within Specified Operating Envelope
narrative_text: Line pressure checked and confirmed within normal operating range (52 bar) per schedule; no anomalies, leaks, or vibration noted across telemetry gauges.
evidence_sentence: Line pressure checked and confirmed within normal operating range per schedule; no anomalies noted.

title: Portable H2S Gas Detector Calibration Overdue by 11 Days
narrative_text: Portable multi-gas detector calibration certificate was found overdue by 11 days during a pre-entry tool box check; unit was immediately tagged out of service before vessel entry was allowed.
exposure_description: Prevented prior to exposure; caught by pre-use verification
potential_consequence: Latent risk of undetected H2S gas pocket if used in unverified state
evidence_sentence: Gas detector calibration was found overdue by 11 days during a pre-use check; unit was pulled from service before entry.

title: Gas Influx Kick Detected During Tripping — Shut-In Delayed for Stand
narrative_text: A 15-barrel mud pit gain and kick was detected on active pit level monitor; well was not immediately shut in per API standard procedure, drilling team continued pulling pipe for 8 minutes to finish the stand.
exposure_description: Drill floor crew directly on rig floor over open rotary table
potential_consequence: Catastrophic deepwater blowout, rig fire, and multi-fatality event
evidence_sentence: A kick was detected; well was not immediately shut in per procedure, drilling continued briefly to finish the stand.

title: Heavy Derrick Hoist Commenced with Undocumented Rigging Inspection
narrative_text: Pre-lift rigging inspection for a 12-ton mud pump module was not documented prior to a scheduled lift; lift proceeded on schedule with workers guiding tagline directly adjacent to the load path.
exposure_description: Workers guiding tagline adjacent to suspended 12-ton load
potential_consequence: Rigging failure causing dropped 12-ton pump on ground crew
evidence_sentence: Rigging inspection was not documented prior to a scheduled lift; lift proceeded on schedule.
